title: About ASSERT
headline: Applied AI for decisions that matter.
intro:
ASSERT builds artificial intelligence that works in the real world: on secure networks, with imperfect data and under strict rules. We combine machine learning, data engineering and domain expertise to deliver systems that people trust and use every day.

We start from the problem, not the algorithm. Each engagement begins with the decision a client needs to make, the data they already hold and the constraints they work under. Then we build, integrate and support the solution until it delivers measurable results.
mission: To give organisations in Greece and Europe AI capabilities that are sovereign, secure and accountable.

values.title: Trust by design
values.text: Explainable models, full audit trails and a human in the loop wherever decisions carry risk.

values.title: Security first
values.text: On-premise, private-cloud and air-gapped deployments for sensitive environments.

values.title: European compliance
values.text: Built in line with GDPR, the EU AI Act and sector-specific regulation.

values.title: Real-world delivery
values.text: We measure success by systems in production, not proofs of concept.

values.title: Local expertise, European reach
values.text: Deep knowledge of the Greek market and public sector, built to scale across the EU.

seo.title: About us
seo.description: ASSERT is a Greek AI company delivering secure, explainable AI for defense, energy, legal and private enterprise.
